name: swave-video
description: SWAVE VIDEO — Self-Hosted & Web-Native Video Editor (Free On-Device & LAN Server Studio for Android, iOS, and Desktop)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n WEB,API -c cyan,green "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm --workspace=@swave/server run start
scripts.build: npm --workspace=@swave/shared run build && npm --workspace=@swave/web run build && npm --workspace=@swave/server run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=@swave/shared run typecheck && npm --workspace=@swave/web run typecheck && npm --workspace=@swave/server run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --workspace=@swave/web run test && npm --workspace=@swave/server run test
